name: Academic Marksheet
description: Manages student records, subjects and marks, and renders/exports per-student result marksheets.

suggests.tecnickcom/tcpdf: Required at runtime for the PDF result route; the code instantiates \TCPDF directly but the class is not declared as a dependency.

project_description: Academic Marksheet is a lightweight student-records and grading module. It creates four custom database tables (student_details, faculty, students_data, marks) via hook_schema, plus three taxonomy vocabularies (courses, semesters, academic_year) on install. Admins add teachers/subjects, teachers assign per-subject marks, and student records are entered manually or imported from a CSV. It renders an on-screen result marksheet per student and exports the same as a PDF via TCPDF. All data access uses the Drupal database API with placeholder-bound conditions; there is no config settings form (it stores runtime data in its own tables, not configuration).
